claim: Wireless phones routinely carry live video
originalWording: Wireless phones routinely carry live video

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: P02 2009 Computers and communications, telephone-communication paragraph

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Wireless personal calls routinely include usable live video, not merely an experimental video phone.
reference.rationale: Wireless voice and webcam meetings were real, but ordinary handset video calling was not yet routine in 2009. Integrated phone cameras, mobile video services and established consumer communication platforms make the function ordinary by the 2010s.
